observations: Literal text preserved; GIF decoded; PNG pixel limitation visible.
Saved binary and edited filename match expected bytes including NUL.
Existing distinct sentinel preserved; invalid destination shows error; later HTTP navigation succeeds.
Cancel returns browser; clean console and sync.
Actual isolated FAT exhaustion removes partial file.
Visible save failure then local welcome recovery and console restoration.

observations: Mouse link hit, address edit,316-byte address exact.

Back returns exactHTTP URL; browser exits, relaunches and exits to readable shell.
